concerns.text: The plan cites 'GlobalCampus/openalex-multilingual-embeddings' (or similar HF subsets) as the source for OpenAlex metadata to match pre-prints. This dataset contains text embeddings, not the structured metadata (arxiv_id, bioRxiv_id, doi, title, authors) required for the matching logic described in FR-001. The plan conflates an embedding dataset with the raw metadata dump. The correct source must be the official OpenAlex S3 bucket (filtered via API or specific metadata snapshots) or a verified HF dataset explicitly containing the 'works' metadata table with these fields, not an embeddings-only subset.

The plan assumes the 'verified Hugging Face subset' of OpenAlex contains the specific fields `arxiv_id` and `bioRxiv_id` for the 2018–2023 window. Standard OpenAlex HF dumps often require specific filtering or are incomplete regarding pre-print server IDs compared to the full S3 dump. Relying on a generic 'subset' without specifying the exact dataset version or confirming the presence of these specific linkage fields risks the entire matching pipeline failing (US-1). The plan must cite the specific dataset version or confirm the API streaming strategy for these specific fields.
